bcphill.msg.500: You don't hear that often in Nevada...
bcphill.msg.501: I don't think I'm interested. Sorry - so long.
bcphill.msg.502: That's right. What happens inside the gang stays inside the gang. We keep to ourselves well enough not to meddle in local squabbles in the towns and settlements. And somebody is taking advantage of that.
bcphill.msg.504: Usually all we leave behind is wild stories about drunken brawls, but lately spiteful tongues have been whispering bad news.
bcphill.msg.506: Someone is ruining our reputation in the state, causing trouble in the settlements and towns out west. Sure, we're not above raising hell ourselves, but what those bastards are doing under our name borders on robbery. And the bikers of Nevada are not robbers.
bcphill.msg.508: Hm, that's not a bad idea. Then keep your ears wide open and listen, because I pay for work.
bcphill.msg.509: Okay, what do I need to do?
bcphill.msg.510: I don't want to get mixed up with people that dangerous. So - count me out.
bcphill.msg.511: You need to find these bastards and punish them. How exactly is up to you. And as proof the job is done, bring me the jackets they use to frighten people. Nobody but us is allowed to wear them. On top of that, they were taken off the bodies of murdered bikers, which matters to us just as much.
bcphill.msg.513: Excellent. I'll wait for news. If you like, I'll drive you to Reno and drop you at the edge of town so I don't get spotted myself. We can't find the swine because somebody warns them over the radio when we're coming. They always manage to slip away.
bcphill.msg.516: I thought you were the robbers.
bcphill.msg.517: When we have to, we'll gut any son of a bitch. But we don't do it for food or for fun.
bcphill.msg.522: No, smart guy, it's done - I've got the jackets.
bcphill.msg.523: Why can't you deal with the bastards yourselves?
bcphill.msg.527: For a job like that - I'll drive you, no question. Are we heading out now?
bcphill.msg.530: We can't sit around outside Reno for days on end, since nobody knows when or where these swine will turn up again. We've also heard from bartenders that somebody warns the bastards over the radio when we're approaching. They always manage to slip away. You don't look like one of us, so it'll be easier for you to catch them off guard.
bcphill.msg.532: Fine work. You've done us a great service. People already think poorly enough of us in Nevada, and when this scum started running riot under our name... that isn't forgiven. I hope they got everything that was coming to them?
bcphill.msg.533: Eh, yes, I did what needed doing.
bcphill.msg.534: Excellent. Here's your pay. I think we ought to see more of each other now - we like you.
bcphill.msg.535: Finally got some respect? That's more like it.
bcphill.msg.536: Hold on. People say a lot of good things about you. I know how hard it is - trying to always be honest and do right. I can't manage it myself, but you... [takes out a revolver] Take it. You should always be protected from scum.
bcphill.msg.537: Now that I'll thank you for!
bcphill.msg.538: Who do you think these people are, the ones framing you?
bcphill.msg.539: Local street thugs in New Reno, most likely. Impostors who've lost their sense of self-preservation. Then again, we've got no shortage of enemies. So it could be anybody.
bcphill.msg.540: Have you heard anything about the stagecoach robbery near Black Rock?
bcphill.msg.541: The locals said something about it, but it doesn't interest me. It was raiders, I'm sure.
bcphill.msg.542: Some people think the bikers did it.
bcphill.msg.543: Is that so? Don't believe spiteful tongues. You have no idea how many ill-wishers and envious types have sprung up around our gang. But we're not bandits and we don't rob stagecoaches. We had nothing to do with it.
bcphill.msg.1530: We can't sit around outside Reno for days on end, since nobody knows when or where these swine will turn up again. We've also heard from bartenders that somebody warns the bastards over the radio when we're approaching. They always manage to slip away. You don't look like one of us, so it'll be easier for you to catch them off guard.
bcphill.msg.1532: Fine work. You've done us a great service. People already think poorly enough of us in Nevada, and when this scum started running riot under our name... that isn't forgiven. I hope they got everything that was coming to them?
bcphill.msg.1533: Eh, yes, I did what needed doing.

fcoxdoc.msg.222: <That's none of your business. Say what you came for or clear off.^That's none of your business. Say what you came for or clear off.>
fcoxdoc.msg.223: <We've got a comedian here. If you won't help me, close the door from the other side.^We've got a comedian here. If you won't help me, close the door from the other side.>
fcoxdoc.msg.224: I could cut off an arm or a leg - joking, don't worry, usually I only cut off fingers. Listen, I only treat the whole carcass at once, meaning everything together - fractures, scratches and poor health. It'll cost you a measly 150 caps.
fcoxdoc.msg.226: Look, the main thing is that you have enough caps.
fcoxdoc.msg.227: <Don't play me for a fool, you're perfectly healthy. Clear off.^Don't play me for a fool, you're perfectly healthy. Clear off.>
fcoxdoc.msg.228: Don't distract me, what do you want?
fcoxdoc.msg.229: We'll sort it out right now, just don't twitch and don't scream.
fcoxdoc.msg.230: You scream like a girl. Ha-ha-ha.
fcoxdoc.msg.231: You scream like a boy. Ha-ha-ha.
fcoxdoc.msg.232: Get ready, now we'll clean out your system [you may have misheard, but he said something about an enema].
fcoxdoc.msg.233: You haven't got any of that muck in you, don't make things up.
fcoxdoc.msg.234: I moved here from Clean Creek, when it was levelled to the ground. There was a big battle there between the military and the raiders - nothing was left of the town, only ruins. After wandering the irradiated wasteland I settled here, and so far I don't regret it. To be honest I'd rather not remember it, it was a long time ago.
fcoxdoc.msg.235: I can't do that sort of thing, it needs special equipment and knowledge. I've heard the Brotherhood of Steel dealt in such things, but they're far from here. I haven't seen them in this region.

leonkill.msg.506: I need to talk to you.
leonkill.msg.5008: I love my rifle, but I can use others without trouble, I can poke about with a knife. I don't like the rest of the weapons, and anyway, as an old friend of mine, Mathilda, used to say: "One shot - one corpse".

ncstragn.msg.119: Striker is about to close a deal on a weapons shipment. I'll tell you everything I know, but I have a condition - I want to go over to Thompson, and quickly.
ncstragn.msg.120: Thompson's people despise turncoats. After the reckoning with Striker they won't go easy on you, don't even hope for it. You'd better get out of here, and far away.
ncstragn.msg.121: Smell something burning? That's right - a reckoning is coming for Striker's whole gang. And you'll be caught in the fire if you don't clear out in time. I'll pass your request on to Thompson.
ncstragn.msg.122: So that's how it is - decided to sell yourself for a better price? They call that "political prostitution". Bah! But so be it - maybe... *maybe* Thompson will take you.
ncstragn.msg.123: Really? I'm done for! You say I'd better run... Well, I've got no choice. I'll have to lie low in one of those little villages, take up farming or hunting. Probably ought to just do that right away.
ncstragn.msg.124: Wow, they'll take me, really? Great! I've wanted to go over to him for ages, honestly! But it's not that simple, you understand?
ncstragn.msg.125: Come on! It's just that I used to, er, think differently. And then I learned about Thompson's ideas and, er, I saw the light! Honestly! I'll do my best, I'll be useful, just give me a chance!
ncstragn.msg.126: Yes, yes, and now let's talk about Striker's deal.
ncstragn.msg.129: Er, that's the one thing I couldn't find out... But I know the data is kept on a terminal in the generator room. You can get in through the back entrance, but the doors are locked.
